📦 Factory 0.240.0 — Droid doctor checks, MCP server recovery — Droid doctor can now check model connectivity, MCP servers, and a complete turn when you opt in; failed MCP servers recover instead of being treated as unavailable, and background commands stop when the Droid process that started them exits. Security: 'Mentioned file safety' — text inside a file you mention with @ can no longer change.

📦 Kiro 2.30.0 — Switch to V3 at Chat Start and Model Fallback Notices — Shows a startup prompt inviting you to switch to V3 as part of a gradual rollout, adds V3 model fallback notices, and keeps more of your V2 agent access when you upgrade agents to V3; also fixes screen reader, tmux, and knowledge search issues.

📦 Copilot: Client telemetry user attribution and configurable capture — Enterprise administrators can now use telemetry in managed settings to attribute GitHub Copilot client telemetry to users, with configurable capture.
